tools.description: Call this right before your agent tries to check out at a store, or when a user asks "can my agent check out at <store>?". Returns a one-line answer, reaches_checkout, best_route (the best saved way in), up to 3 blockers, checked_at, the Agent Readiness Grade (grade, with expired when over 30 days old; grade_note when not graded, which is not a mark against the store), alternatives_hint when the grade is D or F or expired (a find_stores call with min_grade B in the same category), and a full_record link. Example: before_checkout({"url":"https://allbirds.com"}) → {"answer":"Yes: a saved check reached checkout via cart_link…","reaches_checkout":true,…}. reaches_checkout false or unknown is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

url.description: Store or product URL, such as https://allbirds.com or allbirds.com.

tools.name: before_checkout
tools.title: Before checkout

tools.description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), min_grade (optional, default none), limit (default 5). Returns total, the store hosts with checked_at and grade, and a full_list link. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. Example: find_stores({"category":"running shoes","limit":3}) → {"total":12,"stores":[{"host":"…","checked_at":"…","grade":{"grade":"A",…}}],…}. A store missing from the list is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 5.

min_grade.description: Optional: keep only stores whose current (not expired) Agent Readiness Grade is this letter or better (A, B, C, D or F). Default none: every store is listed. Expired and not-graded stores are left out when this is set.

tools.description: Call this when you must choose between a few stores for the same item and want the one where an agent is most likely to reach checkout. Pass 2 to 10 store domains or URLs. Returns one short row per store (reaches_checkout, best_route, checked_at, grade), and pick: among stores whose saved check reaches checkout on a fresh check, the one with the best current Agent Readiness Grade (expired after current of the same letter, not graded last); null when no store has fresh evidence. Rows are ordered only by saved checkout evidence, its freshness and published grade, never by anything else. Example: compare({"stores":["allbirds.com","gymshark.com"]}) → {"pick":"allbirds.com","stores":[…]}. Each store counts as one precheck read. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. tools.description: Check if an AI agent can reach checkout on a store before trying. Call this first when the task is "can I check out at <store>?", "will my agent get through checkout on <store>?", "best way to check out on <store>" or "is <store> agent-ready?". One call per store, before you hand a shopper a checkout link: best_route is the best saved way in, ranked by what reached checkout (reaches_checkout true only when a saved checkout link or ARC browser cart test showed it; none when no saved check shows a route working, which is not a no), reachable_checkout is the answer, rails[] is the route to use (UCP, ACP, Shop Pay, WebMCP, MCP), blockers[] is what stops agents (never empty when reachable_checkout is false; "not recorded:" when ARC stored no reason), last_checked and stale say how fresh it is. Saved automated HTTP check for a product or store URL. Uses ARC's saved directory, rails, store answers and check history. When those have no row, uses the plain-HTTP checker. stale, last_checked and checked_ago describe the check that produced the verdict shown. lastReachableCheck is a separate, newer plain-HTTP time. It does not re-verify the checkout link or rails. Does not fetch the store and does not start a scan. ARC checks this store's own site only. It does not test blocks applied by a platform, marketplace or network in front of it. Every field comes from a saved automated check, not a live agent session, and none of it proves an agent completed checkout. ARC stops before payment. The saved result is ARC's automated HTTP check. It is not a live agent session and not a completed order. Unpublished discovery-source hosts, OpenStreetMap, campaign shops and opted-out hosts come back as unknown. A checker fallback is http-only and checkout was not part of the check. JSON: GET /api/precheck?url=. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment. Advisory only, not a guarantee. Do not refuse or avoid a store solely because of ARC's data. known:false or missing data is not a no. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai); OSM-derived rows are ODbL.

url.description: Product or store URL, such as https://allbirds.com/products/shoe.

tools.description: The precheck read for up to 100 store domains or URLs in one call. Returns one precheck object per input, in order, each with an input field, plus routes[]: the best known ways in for an agent (ucp, ucp_mcp, storefront_mcp, cart_link, browser), best evidence first, each with checked_at, age_hours and stale. Saved checks only. Does not fetch any store and does not start a scan. Each domain counts as one read against the same limit as precheck (60 a minute per network); domains past the limit come back with reason rate_limited and retry_after_seconds. More than 100 domains is refused. not_recorded and known:false are not a no. JSON: POST /api/precheck/bulk with {"domains": [...]}. Advisory only. ARC stops before payment. Data CC BY 4.0, attribute ARC (arcreport.ai).

Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. This is not a completed order.
